question.text: Let <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>O</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></math> be an equilateral triangle with side length unity (<math><mi>O</mi></math> being the origin). Also, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>N</mi></math> are the points of trisection of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi></math> being closer to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>N</mi></math> being closer to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math>. Position vectors of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>M</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>N</mi></math> are <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>m</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>n</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> respectively, then the value of <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>⋅</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>n</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is equal to

solution.text:
m→=2a→+b→3,n→=a→+2b→3
m→⋅n→=192a→+b→⋅a→+2b→
=192a→2+2b→2+5a→⋅b→
=192+2+5×1×1×12=1318
